Animal: Giraffe

Subject: Feedback on Workplace Conduct

Dear [Employee Name],

We value your contributions to the team and want to ensure we maintain a positive and professional work environment for everyone. Recently, we have received feedback regarding some interactions that did not align with our company’s core values.

We believe in open communication and continuous improvement. We would like to discuss this matter with you to understand the context and work together on a path forward that supports your professional growth and reinforces our shared standards of respect and professionalism.

Please let us know when you are available for a brief meeting this week to discuss this further.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
